equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; passengers vs crew members is a population/exposure contrast, not framed as social position.

level_alternative.reason: Crew members are an occupational group, and the Discussion cites employment discipline in explaining their lower rates, though not framed as social position.

notes: Trend inferences come from a linear regression on 7 annual rates and a Cochran-Armitage test on outbreak counts; year-pair contrasts (2012 vs 2011, 2013) use z-tests. The 1990–2004 2.4% decrease is cited from earlier reports. Design inferred as surveillance with trend; none is named.
view_issues: Table † marks 2012 passenger outbreak counts and per-1,000-voyage rates as significant, but text reports no such tests and leaves crew 2012 unmarked though text calls it significant. Bacterial agents in 7 outbreaks (3+4) vs 9 bacterial outbreaks listed (ETEC 6, Shigella, Campylobacter, C. perfringens).
